why: Interfaces whose prototype PRE-EXISTS natively (the arena/cppgc spine, the native singletons, a hand-written class that stores nothing as own properties) and which the installer's backfill pass may therefore fill with the catalogued members the prototype does not own. Anything ending in `Element` qualifies by rule (gen_shells.backfillable); the slot-backed set (slot_backed.json) qualifies too. NOT permanent: an interface joins when its constructor stops assigning own properties (a getter-only prototype accessor would throw in strict mode on `this.x = ...`). Goal W8 says this becomes DERIVED from the table inventory + the cppgc `webapi_objects!` scan once every entry is a table or a cppgc class; until then each entry says why it is here.
